contributions.summary: Entropy-weighted IWTI index from CITES multi-term trade data.
Micro-level IWTer behavioral decision model with Poisson process and profit maximization.
Macro-level government discrete dynamic optimization linking IWT, GDP, and equity goals.
Iterative micro-macro model interaction for 30-year policy projection.

dependency_graph.handoff: IWTI provides historical trade context for micro model calibration
t_i(w_i) feeds into macro model E[Q_IWT] computation

assumptions.summary: Data from official international organization websites is accurate.
All individuals are rational profit maximizers.
Government has sufficient powers to implement all policies.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: CITES trade data for Tanzania pre-processed with minimax normalization.
Entropy method applied to derive IWTI from normalized trade data.
Notation table with 20+ parameters from literature and World Bank.

models.summary: IWTI: Entropy-weighted index from CITES data.
Micro model: IWTer profit maximization with t_i = max(0, -53*w_i + 20).
Macro model: Government goal optimization over 30-year horizon.

verification.summary: Weight-specific sensitivity: weights 0.8/0/0.2 still yield 30-year growth.
Policy-specific sensitivity: 10% variation shows robust conservation goal.

results_trace.summary: IWT eradicated within 16 years under optimal policy.
High-income wage increase 29.5%, low-income 57.5% over 5 years.
Memo: 47.5% salary increase, total IWT elimination after 16 years.
Table 2: 30-year projection of GDP, wages, IWT, and infrastructure.

writing_logic.summary: Abstract uses purpose-bridge framing and dual-model introduction.
Introduction uses power/resources/interest triple for client justification.
Policy section uses bullet-point enumeration with literature backing.
Micro model uses cost-decomposition then revenue-simplification then optimization.
Macro model uses GDP expenditure decomposition for goal formulation.
Memo uses bullet returns format with quantitative highlights.

language_observations.summary: Purpose-bridge opener: To better comprehend...we constructed
We hope that...will bullet pattern for policy recommendations
it can be observed that the higher...the lower pattern
Eradication-claim: can be completely eradicated within N years
Ethical closing: crucial not only for ethical reasons but also for our own survival

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: Micro-macro iterative framework signals sophisticated economic modeling.
30-year projection table with IWT eradication by year 16 demonstrates concrete long-term impact.
Personalized memo to President Hassan with quantitative returns shows practical applicability.

weaknesses.summary: Micro-level data from Tanzanian internet may introduce biased estimates.
Poisson process for wildlife and police arrivals may oversimplify.
Linear wage-IWT relationship (t_i = -53*w_i + 20) is a strong simplification.

independent_extensions.summary: Replace Poisson with spatial point process for wildlife encounters.
Include net exports and trade balance in GDP decomposition.

candidate_rule_impacts.summary: Discrete dynamic optimization with budget constraints for policy allocation.
Entropy-weighted composite index construction from multi-term data.

unresolved_questions.question: How were the coefficients -53 and 20 in the linear wage-IWT relationship derived?
What is the exact value of rho (budget proportion) used?
